 [white[]] [#FF3300[]] Basic interactivity, convenience, and sound effects.
 [white[]] [#FF9900[]] Full wheel customization in the built-in editor
 [white[]] [#CC33CC[]] Built-in color palette
 [white[]] [#003399[]] Wheel library for quick saving and reuse
 [white[]] [#33CC00[]] Extensive control customization options
